cn: 你在地牢里只剩半颗红心，面前有一扇未知的门。你会？
en: You're at half a red heart. A mysterious door stands before you. You:
a_en: Just charge in — I'm used to dying

cn: Boss 战中你只剩最后一滴血。你会？
en: Boss fight, last sliver of HP. You:
a_en: Time to show off my skills!

cn: 你更倾向于哪种战斗方式？
en: Which combat style do you prefer?
a_en: Rush in, melee combat

cn: 面对一大群小怪，你会？
en: Facing a swarm of enemies, you:
a_en: Charge straight into the mob
b_en: Pull and pick them off one by one
c_en: Use bombs/AOE to clear them all at once

cn: 你获得了一个「可能很有用也可能很废」的道具。你会？
en: You get an item that could be great or terrible. You:
a_en: Use it immediately!
b_en: Save it for a critical moment
c_en: Find a chance to test its effect first

cn: 你发现了一个隐藏房间的入口，但没有炸弹。你会？
en: You find a secret room entrance but have no bombs. You:
a_en: Remember the location, come back later
c_cn: 放弃了，不值得为一个房间浪费时间
c_en: Give up — not worth the time

cn: 开局你拿到了一个很差的初始道具。你会？
en: You start with a terrible item. You:
a_en: Whatever, I'll rely on skill

cn: 连续三次在同一个 Boss 手上翻车。你会？
en: You die to the same boss three times in a row. You:
a_en: Again! I won't accept defeat
b_en: Look up a guide for the strategy
c_en: Go farm for better items first

cn: 你的血量已经被削到危险线以下。你会？
en: Your HP is below the danger threshold. You:
a_en: No worries, I can still pull this off

cn: 恶魔房里出现了一个强力道具，但代价是只剩半颗红心。你？
en: Devil room has a powerful item, but it costs leaving you at half a heart. You:
a_en: Take it! Fortune favors the bold
b_cn: 犹豫很久，最后还是拿了

cn: 你更喜欢哪种游戏节奏？
en: What game pace do you prefer?
a_en: Speedrun! Faster is better
c_cn: 慢慢探索，不放过任何角落

cn: 你拿到了一个可以改变整局游戏走向的道具。你会？
en: You get a run-defining item. You:
a_en: Build my entire strategy around it
b_cn: 配合已有的道具一起用
c_en: Just try it and see what happens

cn: 你路过一个金币，但拾取路线会多走几步。你会？
en: A coin is on the ground but picking it up means a detour. You:
a_cn: 弯腰捡起来，有钱不拿是傻子
a_en: Pick it up — free money is free money
b_en: Depends — grab it if it's on the way

cn: 你面前有两条路：一条通向已知的道具房，一条通向未知。你会？
en: Two paths: one leads to a known item room, one is unknown. You:
a_en: Go for the known one, play it safe
b_cn: 先去未知的，万一有更好的
b_en: Try the unknown — might be better

cn: 你发现了一个「可以用血量换道具」的机器。你会？
en: You find a machine that trades HP for items. You:
a_cn: 疯狂献血，直到机器爆炸
a_en: Donate blood until it explodes
b_en: Try a few times to test my luck

cn: 你已经有了一个还不错的 Build。还会继续追求更强的道具吗？
en: You have a decent build. Do you still chase stronger items?
a_en: Of course! Can never be too strong
b_en: It depends — good enough is fine
c_en: Stop gambling, play safe to finish

cn: 你会选择哪个挑战？
en: Which challenge would you pick?
a_en: No-hit clear

cn: 你更享受游戏中的哪个瞬间？
en: Which moment in the game do you enjoy most?
a_en: Clutch boss kill at low HP
c_cn: 抽到超稀有道具的惊喜
c_en: The surprise of getting a rare item

cn: 面对一道你解不开的谜题。你会？
en: Facing a puzzle you can't solve. You:
a_en: Keep trying until I solve it

cn: 你已经玩了 100 小时。你觉得？
en: You've played 100 hours. How do you feel?
a_cn: 才刚开始！还有好多没解锁
a_en: Just getting started! So much left to unlock
b_cn: 差不多了，核心内容都体验了
b_en: Pretty satisfied, experienced most of the core
c_en: Time to move to the next game

cn: 你更倾向于哪种游戏策略？
en: Which gameplay strategy appeals to you?
a_en: Brute force damage build

cn: 你获得了一个可以无限使用但效果随机的主动道具。你会？
en: You get an active item with unlimited uses but random effects. You:
a_en: Spam it — embrace the chaos
b_cn: 在安全的时候偶尔用用
b_en: Use it occasionally in safe moments
c_en: Swap for a more consistent item

cn: 你会选择哪种初始状态？
en: Which starting state would you choose?
a_en: High attack, low HP — quick fights
c_en: High HP, low attack — slow grind

cn: 你在挑战一个从未见过的 Boss。你？
en: You're fighting a boss you've never seen before. You:
a_en: Rush in first to test its damage
c_cn: 死一次记住招式，下次再打
c_en: Die once to learn its moves, then fight properly next time

cn: 你会把多余的道具留给下一关，还是现在就用掉？
en: Save extra items for the next floor, or use them now?
a_en: Use them now — live in the moment
c_cn: 看当前血量和状态再决定
c_en: Decide based on current HP and situation

cn: 你更享受独自游戏还是和朋友一起？
en: Do you prefer playing solo or with friends?
a_en: Solo! My world, my rules
c_cn: 有伴更好，独乐不如众乐
c_en: Better with company — shared fun is more fun

cn: 在多人模式中，你更倾向于？
en: In multiplayer, you tend to:
a_en: Lead the team, call the shots
b_cn: 配合队友，做好自己分内的事
b_en: Support the team, do your part
c_en: Free roam, everyone does their own thing

cn: 你的队友犯了一个低级错误导致团灭。你会？
en: Your teammate makes a noob mistake causing a wipe. You:
a_en: Rage at them!

cn: 你看到别人用了一个你从来没想到的骚操作。你会？
en: You see someone use a clever trick you never thought of. You:
a_en: Learn it immediately!

cn: 你在排行榜上看到自己的名次落后于朋友。你会？
en: You see your ranking is below your friend's. You:
a_en: Not acceptable! I must surpass them!
b_en: A little concerned, but not obsessed
c_cn: 排行榜什么的，无所谓啦
